title: Education benefit program registry (deduplicated across the Education Navigator, the v2.0 build and Sentinel)
rule: Each program appears once, with every build that carried it. Every row is an authority stub: identity and enabling citation only. No rates, caps or eligibility tests are stored, so the funding stack returns UNKNOWN_HUMAN_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED for any combination (gap G3). The Education Navigator's synthetic demonstration grant and its five demonstration institutions are not real programs and are not carried.

programs.name: Post-9/11 GI Bill
programs.stacking_notes: Must elect one with ch. 30, 1606 and 31 (Rudisill nuance); may not combine with TA for the same charges; sequence against the Alabama scholarship unverified.

programs.name: Yellow Ribbon Program
programs.stacking_notes: Requires ch. 33 at the 100% tier; limited, school-funded.

programs.name: Survivors' and Dependents' Educational Assistance (DEA)
programs.note: Finance report cites about $1,574/month full-time for Oct 2025–Sep 2026 (unverified).

programs.name: Federal Tuition Assistance
programs.note: Subject to appropriation. Sentinel's FY26 figures are in guard_reserve.json.

programs.name: Onward to Opportunity (IVMF, Syracuse University)
programs.note: The only real (non-stub) program in the v2.0 registry; the only transition program with a rigorous third-party evaluation per the TAP report.

programs.name: Alabama G.I. Dependents' Scholarship
programs.note: Award cap question open (conflict.ednav.al_award_cap). Whether the Launch 0 finder covers it is an open decision.

programs.name: Alabama National Guard Educational Assistance Program
programs.authority: Ala. Code §31-10 (enabling section unverified; EdNav confidence 0.55)
programs.note: EdNav marks this a stub that can never reach a conclusion (always HUMAN_REQUIRED).
